from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Litigant(BaseModel):
    """A named party involved in the case (e.g., appellant, applicant, respondent)."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the litigant as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Legal role (e.g., Appellant, Applicant, Respondent)")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """Court fee amount and the party responsible for paying it."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Fee amount, e.g., '4300 元'")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee, e.g., specific name or 'Appellant'")
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee, e.g., '二审案件受理费'")

class CaseIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """Case numbers or legal references found in the document."""
    identifier: str | None = Field(description="Case number, e.g., '(2023) 闽 0428 刑初 4 号'")

class Disposition(BaseModel):
    """The specific judicial ruling or action taken in the document."""
    action: str | None = Field(description="Core action, e.g., '驳回上诉', '撤销', '维持', '准许撤回'")
    target: str | None = Field(description="Target of the action, e.g., '原判决', '再审申请'")
    detail: str | None = Field(description="Specific outcome details (e.g., fee burden assignment)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container aggregating all extracted information from a single document."""
    litigants: list[Litigant] = Field(description="All named parties in the case")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="Court fee details and payers")
    case_identifiers: list[CaseIdentifier] = Field(description="All case numbers and document references")
    dispositions: list[Disposition] = Field(description="Judicial rulings and decisions")
    courts: list[str | None] = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the decision")
    dispute_types: list[str | None] = Field(description="Nature of the dispute, e.g., inheritance, administrative penalty")
